## Resolved — Gerrit change 1487, MERGED

https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1487 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted)

**Root cause:** the fixture, not the detector. Two identical 7-line JS files hold a 32-token
duplicated fragment; jscpd's default `--min-tokens` is 50, so the fragment could never reach
the detection floor. Proven by lowering only the floor on the unchanged fixture
(`--min-tokens 10` -> `clones: 1, duplicatedTokens: 32`).

**Not a regression:** `minTokens: 50` is the default in @jscpd/core 3.5.10, 4.0.1 and 5.x
(verified from the published tarballs), and both the test and the runner were introduced by
the single commit `dabf4c6ce2` and never modified since. The test was born RED and CI never
ran it. There was no good->bad transition to bisect.

**RED -> GREEN:** `test_live_clone` was the RED oracle, failing with the reported
`assert 0 >= 1`. Mutation check: shrinking the fixture back below the floor returns it to
RED, so the pass is not vacuous.

**Change:** the duplicated fragment is now built past the documented floor with several times
the margin, and the assertions `clones >= 1` / `percentage > 0` are **unchanged** — the test
was strengthened, not relaxed. Added `test_live_distinct_sources_report_no_clone`, a negative
control (both files above the floor, no shared fragment) so a detector reporting clones
unconditionally could not satisfy the positive case; it also goes RED under mutation.

**Sibling sweep:** jscpd is the only live tool in the suite with a minimum-size detection
floor (scc counts lines, semgrep/ctags/ssh-keygen are rule- or content-driven). Ran the whole
CI-skipped live-tool class with jscpd, scc, ctags, semgrep, ssh-keygen and sha256sum present
— 385 passed, so no other member of the "green in CI only because it skips" class is red.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Root cause established with evidence — fixture below jscpd's default token floor; not a
      jscpd behaviour change, not fixture drift, not a detector regression.
- [x] `test_live_clone` passes against the installed jscpd (5.0.14). No version range needed:
      the default floor is identical on 3.x/4.x/5.x, so the enlarged fixture is detected on
      any of them.
- [x] Duplication confirmed to report real clones on jscpd 5.x, not silently zero:
      `analyze(src/rebar)` -> `{'clones': 194, 'percentage': 1.748}`.

**Residual risk filed:** 5590-1c13-004c-47e1 (linked `discovered_from`) — jscpd reports
`clones: 0, percentage: 0` with `sources: 0` when nothing clears the token floor, which is
indistinguishable from genuine zero duplication in the two fields rebar reads. Narrow in
practice (any real repo has sources above the floor) and it needs a product decision, so it
was deliberately left out of this fix.
